about: Born when characters turn invisible/visible (shadow enemies in TWN Morgue, Jailbreak/Oathbreaker dialogues). Two delay timers and flags, one per fade view (InvisibilityFadeView0/1); ecl::invisibility::EffectSystem counts them down and then queues a fade request.

evidence.says: bg3.exe+0x1A45990 (invisibility effect update): while +0xA is set, subtracts frame time from +0 and, when <= 0, clears +0xA and pushes a fade request for view 0 (twin of the +4/+0xB path read in full). Creator bg3.exe+0x1A4CC40 writes 0. Live 0..2.54.

bg3.exe+0x1A45990: when the byte at +0xB is set, subtracts the frame time from the float at +4 and stores it back; when the result is <= 0 it clears the byte at +0xB and queues the fade request of view 1. Creator writes 0. Live 0..2.54.

bg3.exe+0x1A45990 copies whether the byte at +8 is non-zero into the first word of the fade request of view 0 (FadeView TargetValue side). Creator bg3.exe+0x1A4CC40 writes 1 (32-bit store of 1 over +8..+B). Live 0/1.
bg3.exe+0x1A45990 copies whether the byte at +9 is non-zero into the fade request of view 1 (call with view index 1). Live 0/1.
bg3.exe+0x1A45990: gates the countdown of +0; component is removed when +0xA and +0xB are both 0. Live 0/1.
bg3.exe+0x1A45990: gates the countdown of +4 and is cleared when it runs out; removal when +0xA == +0xB == 0. Live 1.

open_questions: The +0/+8/+A path was read only by symmetry with the +4/+9/+B path (same function, twin code); exact meaning of the copied flag (visible vs. invisible) not verified.
